rules.rule: Agreements are contracts when made with free consent by parties competent to contract, for lawful consideration and a lawful object, and not expressly declared void by the Act.
rules.plain_language: Check the parties, assent, capacity, consideration, lawful object and any other applicable form requirements.
rules.scenario_relevance: The buyer order is described as a contract, but the signed terms and L/C documents are not supplied for review.

rules.rule: Parties must perform, or offer to perform, their promises unless performance is dispensed with or excused under the Act or another law.
rules.plain_language: Start with the promises each party actually made and whether performance was due or excused.
rules.scenario_relevance: Compare the 500-sari order terms and approved specifications with the batch delivered and any cure obligations.

rules.topic: Failure to perform at a specified time
rules.rule: Where a promise is due by a specified time, the effect of delay depends in part on whether the parties intended time to be of the essence; the section distinguishes the consequences.
rules.plain_language: A missed deadline does not have one automatic result; read the contract and circumstances.
rules.scenario_relevance: The project says production was rushed but gives no delivery dates or time-is-essential term.

rules.rule: Compensation may be available for loss that naturally arose in the usual course of things or that the parties knew was likely; remote and indirect loss is excluded.
rules.plain_language: A damages claim depends on proof, causation, foreseeability and the contract; remote loss is not compensable under this section.
rules.scenario_relevance: If the delivered saris breached the agreed terms, assess proven foreseeable loss and mitigation; do not state a damages amount without evidence.
